bio.text: C. Scott Grow represents Idaho Senate District 14, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which says he was appointed on August 15, 2018, to fill a vacancy in the district.
The directory biography describes Grow as an Idaho native raised in Boise who raised eight children in Meridian with Rhonda.
It describes him as a small business owner, business consultant and retired CPA who was elected twice to the Meridian School Board.
